name: Stacked outline
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: One bold filled word above three outlined copies of that same word; centered four-row stack.
design.motion: The four word rows separate vertically into the stack, hold, then collapse away.
design.bestFor: A single-word emphasis or short chapter label with a large clear area.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Three-line cascade
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: A script word above two bold stacked lines, with independently editable copy and colors.
design.motion: Authored elastic script movement followed by the bold-line reveals, a reading hold, then the reverse exit.
design.bestFor: Three short related lines on a deliberate title card with clear space; keep every line meaningful.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Split stack
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: Two heavy filled text lines tilted together diagonally, with repeated letterforms; broad poster-like composition.
design.motion: Authored text entrance and exit around a static diagonal reading hold.
design.bestFor: Two short related words on a clean background or a dedicated title card.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Scrolling outline
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: A tall, tilted column of many alternating filled and outlined copies of the same word.
design.motion: Repeated word rows animate into and out of a diagonal stacked reading hold.
design.bestFor: A deliberate full-title visual beat, not a small subtitle or lower third.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Rising word
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: One filled word across the center with outlined copies fanning in curved trails above its left side and below its right side.
design.motion: The repeated outlined word trails reveal around the central filled word and retract on exit.
design.bestFor: A short emphatic word on a dedicated card or a large empty background, not a compact lower third.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Split two-line
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: Two filled bold lines with independently editable text and colors and multiple outlined echoes stepping diagonally behind both words.
design.motion: The filled words and outlined echoes animate into and out of a stepped two-line hold.
design.bestFor: A bold two-word title card, with meaningful copy on both lines and ample clear space around the echoes.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.

name: Two-line reveal
description: Editable bold kinetic title with authored text animation and a transparent background. Keep the copy short.

design.layout: Two bold lines split into left and right halves, surrounded by outlined copies fanning diagonally; a large decorative title composition.
design.motion: The filled halves and outlined echoes spread into a diagonal stack, hold, then retract.
design.bestFor: A concise two-line title on a dedicated card or a large empty area, with two or more characters per line.
design.avoid: Do not repeat burned-in captions, cover a face/product, or use as decoration. Use short source-grounded copy and leave a readable hold.
